entities.name: Tāufaʻāhau Tupou IV of Tonga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tāufaʻāhau Tupou IV was King of Tonga from 1965 until his death in 2006. He was the tallest and heaviest Tongan monarch, weighing 209.5 kg (462 lb) and measuring 196 cm.
